tasks.question: Search and download GDP per capita and life expectancy data for at least 5 countries from a reliable source. Analyze the correlation between economic development and health outcomes, generate a plot, and summarize your findings.
tasks.final_answer: Collected real World Bank 2023 data for 8 countries on GDP per capita and life expectancy, found a moderately strong positive log-linear correlation (r=0.78, R²=0.61), and produced a verified scatter+regression plot (scatter_regression.png) and full markdown report (analysis_report.md).
